title: Application Form for Exit (ME-ME)
text:
KEY LINES:
I am applying to avail the Exit provision as per the details given below:

FULL TEXT:
RANCHI UNIVERSITY, RANCHI
APPLICATION FORMAT FOR EXIT IN ME-ME PROVISION
I am …………………………………………… (Name), Student of …………………………………………
(Name of HEI), …………………………. (Place) having the Registration No. ………...……….……………
& Examination Roll No. ………………………….….
(√ mark the appropriate box & fill the particulars)
I am applying to avail the Exit provision as per the details given below:
For Exit from FYUGP
1. Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) Session …………………...
Major ……………………………… (Name of Subject)
Minor 1……………………………... Minor 2 ……………………………... (Name of Subject)
Double Major instead of Minor ……………………………………….……. (Name of Subject)
2. Exit after Semester II (Level 4.5) with Undergraduate Certificate
3. Exit after Semester IV (Level 5) with Undergraduate Diploma
4. Exit after Semester VI (Level 5.5) with Undergraduate Degree
For Exit from NEP PG
1. NEP 2-Year Postgraduate Programme (NEP PG) Session …………………...
2. Programme studied ………………………………………. (Name of Subject)
3. Exit after Semester II (Level 6) with Postgraduate Diploma
Declaration.
I declare that I have …………………(appeared in/passed) the End Semester University Examination
ESUE ………………(year).
I further declare that I have completed the mandatory 2-month Summer Internship/ Apprenticeship/
Project of 4 credits after enrolment in the said programme. The copy of the Certificate/Document is
attached to this application.
I may be issued the required certificate, subject to the fulfilment of the conditions that all course
credits are successfully completed and that no courses are pending against my name.
Name & Signature of the Student Forwarded by the Head of the Institution
Signature & seal
For Office use only:
Ref. No: ………………….……
Date: ……………………………
